notes: Business preset: LinkedIn and Instagram take the full 10-slide carousel; this 16:9 hero serves Facebook and X only. A deep groove worn into a concrete floor by repetition, raking cream light, red along one segment. Approved on the second roll. Roll 1 (hero-01.jpg) returned an ECG heartbeat -- the generic result flagged as the risk in the brief -- with a faint blue-teal haze in the background, and its red spike read as "the anomaly the tool caught", nearly the inverse of the post's argument. The re-roll excludes waveforms and graphs by name.
